desc:
✨Tribute to the anime 'Solo Leveling' and all loyal players✨
Early game priorities: Hero Rise > Hero Upgrade > Hero Level > Raid > Hero Abilities > Hero Stars; late-game gear like outfits, gems, weapons, mounts, etc., explore on your own.

🔥 Step into the shadows and become the ultimate hunter!
In this immersive RPG, you wake up as a 'Player System' and become a hunter. Conquer dungeons, tame monster pets, and build your own shadow army!

Key Features:
🦅 Pet System: Catch, fuse, cast, and evolve unique shadow companions!
⚔️ Character Progression: Level up, slot gems, and wield magical weapons to unleash god-like powers!
🐎 Monster Mastery: Tame dungeon bosses and ride them into battle!
🌌 Abyss Challenges: Solo tower climbs, cooperative raids, and epic boss battles in the original storyline!

"Get stronger or perish... the system is watching." Code: welcome
